body.purpose: Prose and control text. The reading column stays under 68 characters. A table sets its text at 0.9rem.

button.purpose: The label of every .btn. A row's identity button and a menu item keep the body text.

label.purpose: A field label, a kicker, a menu group label, a term in the profile register.

legend.purpose: A table header, a fieldset legend, a section heading on the step page.

mono.purpose: A stamp. The register tab tracks it wider, at 0.14em. A machine value inside running text takes the mono face at the size around it, with no uppercase.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: A dialog, over a backdrop of black at 45%.

motion.name: usage-flash
motion.purpose: The one animation. When an author writes in the field catalog, the steps that write reached flash the accent. Under reduced motion it never runs.

motion.name: reduced-motion-reset
motion.purpose: A global rule in shell/global.css under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. No component declares a transition.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: The header wraps, and the nav takes a row of its own. The profile register drops to one column.

breakpoints.name: register-row
breakpoints.purpose: An app register row drops to one column. Its quantity moves to the left.

breakpoints.name: studio-stack
breakpoints.purpose: A studio tab body stacks its columns. A rail leaves its side column and caps its height at 20rem.

breakpoints.name: reading-column
breakpoints.purpose: The cap for app screens and the shell's own screens. A participant reads.

breakpoints.name: tool-surface
breakpoints.purpose: The cap for admin, reporting and studio screens. An operator scans. The process surface takes no cap.

breakpoints.name: step-form-container
breakpoints.purpose: A container query: the step form stacks at 34rem of its own width.

narrative.overview:
Detent moves a case through explicit states. The interface is the record of that movement. Two devices carry the whole identity. A ruled row holds the case. A stamp marks the state it reached.

Nothing floats. No surface pretends to be a card when it is a row in a register. Alignment and rules organize the page. Shadow, color and radius do not.

The screen prints two kinds of value. Prose takes the written face. A value the engine matches exactly takes the mono face. The split itself is a signal.

The studio adds a selection mark in the accent. It shows what is open, pressed or current. A 2px rule sits under an open tab. A 3px rule sits on the leading edge of the current row.
keyCharacteristics: Zero radius on every box. Only the canvas's SVG geometry curves.
Two structural rule weights, and nothing between them.
One accent, used as a stamp and as a selection mark, never as a ground.
Machine values in mono, prose in the written face.
Flush-left alignment, including inside a wide button.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: The accent marks state, selection, and one primary action per screen. It never becomes the ground under content.

rules.name: The Five Tones Rule
rules.body: A stamp has five tones and no sixth. Adding one is a design change. A single screen never decides it.

rules.name: The Never Green Rule
rules.body: A settled case prints in ink. Success never turns green. A destructive action stays outlined in the accent and never turns red.

rules.name: The Role Rule
rules.body: A component reads a semantic role, never a ramp step and never a hex. The three flag tokens are the only exception. A component compiled with StyleX reads that role from packages/form-ui/src/tokens.stylex.ts, which aliases the same custom property tokens.css declares. Advisory and Dormant still need a role there.

rules.name: The Machine Face Rule
rules.body: A string takes mono only when you can name the reason. Otherwise it takes the written face.

rules.name: The Tracking Floor Rule
rules.body: A tracked label stays at 11px or above. Its uppercase tracking must survive umlauts and eszett.

rules.name: The Long German Rule
rules.body: German runs up to 40% longer than English. No control derives its width from the English label. No stamp takes a fixed width: a two-line stamp is correct, a clipped one is not.

rules.name: The Escape Hatch Rule
rules.body: A shadow marks an element that left the page. On the page there is no shadow, at rest or on hover. The inset selection mark is the one exception, because it draws a rule.

rules.name: The Zero Radius Rule
rules.body: Every box is square. No size, no state and no surface earns a curve. The canvas's SVG geometry is the one exception.

rules.name: The Mark Rule
rules.body: A selection mark shows what is open, pressed or current. It never separates one region from another. Only the accent draws it, at 2px or 3px.

rules.name: The Still Page Rule
rules.body: A state changes at once. A new animation counts as a design change.

dos: Do give a screen exactly one filled primary action.
Do print a machine value in mono. That means an id, a hash, a version, a role name, CEL, or a figure in a column.
Do name a state with a stamp in one of the five tones.
Do mark an open, pressed or current item with a selection mark.
Do declare a component's styles with stylex.create() beside its module.
Do pick a state's compiled style in code. Read the value that also sets the DOM attribute, such as aria-current.
Do name a literal class prefix-block-element, one hyphen per level, with a variant as a suffix class.
Do wrap a row's identifying content in a real control.
Do give a row of secondary studio commands the authoring command style.
donts: Don't add a sixth stamp tone.
Don't read a primitive or a hex from a component. Read a role.
Don't read another area's style object. Move a shared motif into shell/.
Don't turn success green, or a destructive action red.
Don't put a drop shadow on a resting surface, or on a hover state.
Don't draw a structural rule in the accent.
Don't report an error as a toast, or let an empty table stand in for one.
Don't size a control from its English label.
Don't turn a state into a class name.
Don't add a literal class outside the .btn family. Declare a compiled style.
